usage: The word 梳化 is a noun used to refer to a sofa or couch.
梳化 is generally used to describe furniture found in living rooms where people sit and relax.
You can use 梳化 in sentences to specify the location of the sofa, such as 梳化喺邊度？ meaning 'Where is the sofa?'.
梳化 can be used in both singular and plural contexts, depending on whether you are talking about one sofa or multiple sofas.
When describing comfort or size, 梳化 often appears with adjectives, e.g., 呢張梳化好舒服 means 'This sofa is very comfortable.'
